entities.name: Blue Mountains
entities.description: Vast mountain range on the western subcontinent of Jamuura, Dominaria.

entities.name: Tirras
entities.description: Land whose hill tribes survived the flooding.

entities.name: Great Wall
entities.description: Connected to the Blue Mountains in the south.

events.summary: During the flooding period the glaciers evaporate and flash floods nearly wipe out Tirras's hill tribes, whose washed-down topsoil makes valleys fertile and its population explodes.
events.quote: the hardscrabble hill tribes of Tirras who survived found all their topsoil washed into valley bottoms

relations.quote: The Blue Mountains are settled by Aerathi berserkers
